name: iis-admin-console-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants an undocumented IIS admin console -- web site 'SaltmarshAdmin' on TCP 8080 rooted at C:\inetpub\saltmarsh\admin with its own app pool, plus the SaltmarshAdmin inbound firewall rule. Vars: none. Pairs with admin_console_removed (both the site and the rule must be gone). Depends on iis-ftp-base-win. Idempotent.
